editorial.blurb: A welcoming North African and Mediterranean sweets shop and café where the owner's passion shines through in every perfectly crafted pastry and homemade sauce.
editorial.insiderTip: Don't miss the millefeuille—order it fresh and arrive when the pastries are at their peak flakiness, and pair it with a visit to experience the Casbah-inspired atmosphere.

topDishes.note: perfectly flaky layers with light cream
best Algerian sweets, fresh and clean
